newspaper.headline: Fake Delivery Receipts Spread Through Chat Apps
newspaper.lead: Messages with a "delivery receipt" that is really a harmful app are spreading fast. People are advised not to install .apk files from messages, even if the name looks like a PDF.

impact.good: Yesterday, every attempt to steal accounts with OTP codes failed at Nusa Digital. Suspicious accounts were secured right away.
impact.mixed: Yesterday, most accounts were secured, but a few strange logins were missed.
impact.bad: Yesterday, some employee accounts were taken over because strange logins were missed. Passwords are being changed.

tip.title: Tip: Look at the Last Ending
tip.text: Resi.pdf.apk is an Android app, not a PDF. The file type is set by the ending furthest to the right in its name.

newspaper.classified: A PACKAGE FOR YOU is on its way. Don't forget to open it. — K.

boss.title: Mystery Parcels
boss.intro: Files, emails and logins arrive all at once before home time. Check the source and the content before you decide.
